insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 8 G3+ games, 17/40 picks (42%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 42 champs in G1s, 31 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rell? They go Leona
insights.text: Rell is a G1 favorite (6/19 G1s, played by ProDelta). In the 8 later games where it was burned or banned, ProDelta went to Leona (2/8) and Nautilus (2/8).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Azir is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Azir in 15/39 games (38%): 2 picks (0-2) and 13 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: G1 first pick: Gwen
insights.text: With first pick in Game 1 they took Gwen 3/9 times (33%). Overall 2-4 on it. Ban it or be ready to answer it in G1.
